title: Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game?
abstract: arXiv:2610.13948v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models increasingly support or automate information retrieval from document collections too large to index. This task is difficult when it requires specialist linguistic or scientific knowledge. We used the Wikipedia Game to test language models on an analogous information retrieval task. In the game, players must reach a target article using only article links. We compared sentence embedding models and LLMs across five Wikipedia languages and five academic-literature datasets. We construct very large local graphs of Wikipedia pages and of paper citations using OpenAlex and provide code to build and navigate them. This allows the study of language models' navigation capabilities without relying on third-party APIs. We compared the models with human and TF-IDF benchmarks. translated_title: 语言模型能玩维基百科游戏吗？
translated_abstract: 语言模型日益用于支持或自动化从过于庞大而无法建立索引的文档集合中进行信息检索的任务。当该任务需要专业的语言学或科学知识时，难度会显著增加。我们使用维基百科游戏来测试语言模型在类似信息检索任务上的表现。在该游戏中，玩家必须仅通过文章之间的链接到达目标文章。我们在五种维基百科语言和五个学术文献数据集上比较了句子嵌入模型与大型语言模型（LLM）。我们利用OpenAlex构建了规模非常大的本地维基百科页面图和论文引用图，并提供了构建和导航这些图的代码。这使得我们无需依赖第三方API即可研究语言模型的导航能力。我们将这些模型与人类表现和TF-IDF基准进行了比较。维基百科游戏的形式能够在不同技术、语言和领域之间实现稳健的比较。没有模型显著超越人类，尽管表现最好的模……
tldr: 该论文提出以维基百科游戏作为信息检索基准，通过OpenAlex构建大规模本地维基百科页面图与论文引用图，在多语言和多学术数据集上系统比较句子嵌入模型与大语言模型的导航检索能力，发现没有任何模型能显著超越人类表现。
en_tdlr: This paper uses the Wikipedia Game as a benchmark to evaluate information retrieval capabilities, constructing large local Wikipedia page graphs and OpenAlex citation graphs to compare sentence embedding models and LLMs across five languages and five academic datasets, finding that no model significantly outperforms humans.
